Name: Furry Farmer
Author: Krystedez
Description:
[center][b][font=Times New Roman][size=6]FURRY FARMER
[/size][color=#ff0000]~Please Read Carefully Before Beginning!~[/color]

[size=6]Steps: [/size][b][font=Times New Roman][size=6] (Follow each page's instructions please.)
[/size][/font][/b][size=3][u]0. Again, read everything first!
[/u]
[color=#6fa8dc]1. [/color]Install all Required Tools/Mods
[color=#6fa8dc]2.[/color] Install all Necessary Mods
[color=#6fa8dc]2.a.[/color] (Optional) Install Recommended Mods
[color=#6fa8dc]3.[/color] Install [u]this[/u] mod (Furry Farmer)[/size]

[size=6]How to Use:[/size]
[size=3][color=#8e7cc3]4. [/color]Start up your game and use the cog wheel at the title screen
[color=#8e7cc3]5. [/color]Click "Furry Farmer" in the menu
[color=#8e7cc3]6. [/color]Adjust species/eyes/arms/etc how you see fit (don't use custom unless you made one yourself and know what you're doing)
[color=#8e7cc3]7. [/color]Hit "Save" and then "Save&Close"
[color=#8e7cc3]8. [/color]Go back and Load an existing Save. [b][font=Times New Roman] Pay no mind to the preview until you're in game.
[/font][/b][color=#8e7cc3]8.a. [/color]If you start a new save, be sure to select "Start with Mirror" in save upon character creation.
[color=#8e7cc3]9. [/color]Go buy the hand-mirror from Pierre, unless you did step 8.a., in which case it's in your mailbox.
[color=#8e7cc3]10. [/color]Use the hand-mirror, and a new window will pop up, allowing you to select FashionSense modpack accessories/appendages/etc... that you need to bring life to your character and make them look like what you want!

[b][font=Times New Roman][color=#ffff00]FashionSense and it's modpacks you should have installed allow you to pick ears/tails/etc..., so don't forget![/color][/font][/b][/size]

[b][font=Times New Roman][size=6]3. How To Install
[/size]Extract the rar file using Winrar or 7zip, and put it's contents, "[CP] Furry Farmer" into your mods folder! It should look like
[color=#00ffff]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Furry Farmer[/color]
If you have latest Content Patcher / SMAPI, it should work.
[/font][/b]

[size=6]About[/size]
This is a overhaul to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2561]Anthro Farmer Continued [/url]﻿made by LackeDragon/rainrtw, and gives the power to the end-user to customize their farmer to their heart's content. There is even a guide within to help a user create their own species, arms, feet, etc.. if they so wish, and can submit to us here via the forums in DM!

It makes the character a species of the player's choosing! Be sure to install all of the necessary and recommended mods before using this, and read the FAQ/Readme!

[size=6]Important Notes:[/size]

1.) Furry Farmer Team asks that you contain updates or contributions to this project and submit them here if you'd like them featured and your name credited. Wanna create an elephant? How about a farmer that looks like a bee? Go for it!﻿2.) Ensure you have the proper mod dependencies or your experience will be less than stellar. If you'd like to craft your own ears and paste them to the model, feel free to use the custom spot to do so, or wait for someone else to contribute them. But tails and ears are much easier to use from FashionSense pack Animals and Mythology
3.) READ THE README and FAQ!

Thanks for reading, and have fun!


[b][font=Times New Roman][b][font=Times New Roman][size=6]FAQ:[/size][/font][/b][/font][/b]

[b][font=Times New Roman][u]Q1. Where are ears and tails, etc...?[/u]
[/font][/b]A1: Read everything in this page, and follow the Steps and How-to Use sections. They are tied to Fashion Sense and it's modpacks. If you don't have these, no ears/tails/etc...
[u]
Q2. Why won't my sprite show up properly when loading a save file?[/u]
A2: Sometimes it does, but most likely it won't and you need to load/start a save and get in-game first to see stuff reflecting your customizations.

[u]Q3. I don't see anything in-game changing my farmer![/u]
A3. Again, ensure you've installed everything and you don't have any mod dependencies from other mods manipulating your farmer, because they will likely break / not work well with this mod.
